outcome: APGAR score at the fifth minute
cohort: Premature infants with gestational age ≤32 gestational weeks
finding: Early hyperglycemia in very low birth weight premature infants was significantly associated with a lower APGAR score at the fifth minute, increased incidence of necrotizing enterocolitis, shorter duration of mechanical ventilation, and higher mortality.
mod_finding: This study found no significant difference in mode of delivery between preterm infants with normoglycemia and hyperglycemia.
